methodology: Convolutional neural network (CNN)-based hierarchical deep multi-task learning framework (DeepMT-DR) utilizing a novel task-aware loss to simultaneously optimize low-level image super-resolution (ISR), mid-level lesion segmentation, and high-level disease severity classification (DR grading).
key_findings: Image super-resolution (ISR) boosts the performance of both DR grading and lesion segmentation, with lesion segmentation regions showing high consistency with pathological regions for DR grading. The proposed DeepMT-DR framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art DR grading methods across three datasets while achieving comparable performance in the auxiliary tasks of ISR and lesion segmentation.
